summary: In Tirisfal Glades, Executor Zygand sends you against the Scarlet Crusade. Executor Arren has recovered intelligence, and your first target is Scarlet Warriors at a tower west of Solliden Farmstead. The strike begins the Forsaken campaign to drive the crusaders from their borders.

sections.title: A Two-Front War
sections.body: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's Forsaken face threats on several fronts. The Deathguard watches the Lich King's growing armies, while the Scarlet Crusade challenges Forsaken rule over their former homeland. The Crusade calls all undead abominations to be purged with fire and blade. Its zealots do not see that the Forsaken have broken free of the Scourge's control.

sections.title: Striking the Western Outpost
sections.body: At Deathknell, Executor Arren secured documents showing where Scarlet encampments and outposts lie across Tirisfal Glades. The Deathguard is busy containing the Scourge, so independent Forsaken champions strike the zealots directly. Their first target is a guard tower west of Solliden Farmstead. Scarlet Warriors gather there and threaten the western approaches to Brill.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade hostile toward the Forsaken?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade is an extremist human order devoted to eradicating the undead. It makes no distinction between the mindless Scourge under the Lich King and the free-willed Forsaken loyal to Lady Sylvanas. To the Crusade, every undead is a plague-ridden monster to be burned.

Executor Zygand is the senior military officer of the Forsaken Deathguard stationed in Brill. He directs military deployments, defends the roads approaching the capital, and oversees strikes against nearby Scarlet and Scourge forces.

faq.q: How did the Forsaken get intelligence on Scarlet positions?
aliases: how did they find the tower
faq.answer: Recruits serving Executor Arren recovered tactical documents in Deathknell. The papers described Scarlet patrol routes, outposts, and encampments throughout Tirisfal. Executor Zygand used that information to plan targeted counter-attacks.

faq.q: Where are the Scarlet Warriors located?
faq.answer: Scarlet Warriors hold a defensive tower west of Solliden Farmstead, in the western countryside of Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Deathguard handle the Crusade directly?
faq.answer: The Deathguard's ranks are stretched thin watching the Scourge, whose forces grow in number each night under the Lich King's reach. With regular soldiers occupied containing them, Zygand relies on independent Forsaken champions to strike the Crusaders.

faq.q: Does this mission end the Scarlet presence in Tirisfal?
aliases: is this the last scarlet quest
faq.answer: No. The attack on the western watchtower is the first strike in a four-part campaign. Executor Zygand directs it to dismantle Scarlet command and outposts across the region.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you face living former countrymen who call you monsters and seek your eradication, rather than mourn Lordaeron's tragic fall.
As Horde, you need a secure border around Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity. It gives the Horde a permanent foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
